passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.1
passages.text: Sicelides Musae, paulo maiora canamus!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.2
passages.text: Non omnis arbusta iuvant humilesque myricae;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.3
passages.text: si canimus silvas, silvae sint consule dignae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.4
passages.text: Ultima Cumaei venit iam carminis aetas;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.5
passages.text: magnus ab integro saeclorum nascitur ordo:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.6
passages.text: iam redit et Virgo, redeunt Saturnia regna;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.7
passages.text: iam nova progenies caelo demittitur alto.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.8
passages.text: Tu modo nascenti puero, quo ferrea primum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.9
passages.text: desinet ac toto surget gens aurea mundo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.10
passages.text: casta fave Lucina: tuus iam regnat Apollo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.11
passages.text: Teque adeo decus hoc aevi te consule inibit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.12
passages.text: Pollio, et incipient magni procedere menses.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.13
passages.text: te duce, si qua manent sceleris vestigia nostri,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.14
passages.text: inrita perpetua solvent formidine terras.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.15
passages.text: ille deum vitam accipiet, divisque videbit

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.16
passages.text: permixtos heroas, et ipse videbitur illis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.17
passages.text: pacatumque reget patriis virtutibus orbem.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.18
passages.text: At tibi prima, puer, nullo munuscula cultu

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.19
passages.text: errantis hederas passim cum baccare tellus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.20
passages.text: mixtaque ridenti colocasia fundet acantho.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.21
passages.text: Ipsae lacte domum referent distenta capellae

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.22
passages.text: ubera, nec magnos metuent armenta leones;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.23
passages.text: ipsa tibi blandos fundent cunabula flores,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.24
passages.text: occidet et serpens, et fallax herba veneni

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.25
passages.text: occidet, Assyrium volgo nascetur amomum.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.26
passages.text: at simul heroum laudes et facta parentis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.27
passages.text: iam legere et quae sit poteris cognoscere virtus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.28
passages.text: molli paulatim flavescet campus arista,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.29
passages.text: incultisque rubens pendebit sentibus uva,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.30
passages.text: et durae quercus sudabunt roscida mella

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.31
passages.text: Pauca tamen suberunt priscae vestigia fraudis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.32
passages.text: quae temptare Thetim ratibus, quae cingere muris

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.33
passages.text: oppida, quae iubeant telluri infindere sulcos:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.34
passages.text: alter erit tum Tiphys, et altera quae vehat Argo

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.35
passages.text: delectos Heroas; erunt etiam altera bella,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.36
passages.text: atque iterum ad Troiam magnus mittetur Achilles.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.37
passages.text: Hinc, ubi iam firmata virum te fecerit aetas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.38
passages.text: cedet et ipse mari vector, nec nautica pinus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.39
passages.text: mutabit merces: omnis feret omnia tellus:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.40
passages.text: non rastros patietur humus, non vinea falcem;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.41
passages.text: robustus quoque iam tauris iuga solvet arator;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.42
passages.text: nec varios discet mentiri lana colores:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.43
passages.text: ipse sed in pratis aries iam suave rubenti

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.44
passages.text: murice, iam croceo mutabit vellera luto;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.45
passages.text: sponte sua sandyx pascentis vestiet agnos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.46
passages.text: Talia saecla, suis dixerunt, currite, fusis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.47
passages.text: concordes stabili fatorum numine Parcae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.48
passages.text: Adgredere o magnos—aderit iam tempus—honores,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.49
passages.text: cara deum suboles, magnum Iovis incrementum!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.50
passages.text: Aspice convexo nutantem pondere mundum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.51
passages.text: terrasque tractusque maris caelumque profundum!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.52
passages.text: Aspice, venturo laetentur ut omnia saeclo!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.53
passages.text: O mihi tam longae maneat pars ultima vitae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.54
passages.text: spiritus et quantum sat erit tua dicere facta!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.55
passages.text: Non me carminibus vincet nec Thracius Orpheus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.56
passages.text: nec Linus, huic mater quamvis atque huic pater adsit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.57
passages.text: Orphei Calliopea, Lino formosus Apollo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.58
passages.text: Pan etiam, Arcadia mecum si iudice certet,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.59
passages.text: Pan etiam Arcadia dicat se iudice victum.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.60
passages.text: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.61
passages.text: matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.62
passages.text: Incipe, parve puer, cui non risere parentes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 4.63
passages.text: nec deus hunc mensa, dea nec dignata cubili est.
